values.down-script: :delay 15s; :if ([/tool netwatch get [find name="cf-dnsguard"] status] = "down") do={/ip firewall nat disable [find comment="cf-dnsguard:hijack"]; :foreach c in=[/ip firewall connection find where dst-port=53 and dstnat and reply-src-address=10.0.0.2] do={:do {/ip firewall connection remove $c} on-error={}}}
values.name: cf-dnsguard
values.up-script: /ip firewall nat enable [find comment="cf-dnsguard:hijack"]; :foreach c in=[/ip firewall connection find where dst-port=53 and !dstnat and dst-address!=10.0.0.2 and src-address!=10.0.0.2 and src-address!=10.0.0.4 and src-address!=10.0.0.50] do={:do {/ip firewall connection remove $c} on-error={}}
